title: Caching & Batching — Do Not Recompute the Same Answer
key_insight: A cache stores a result under a key and reuses it for matching requests. The key must include every input that can change the correct result.
body:
## Do Not Recompute the Same Answer

Thousands of users request the same public summary. Calling the model each time repeats cost and delay.

A cache stores a result under a key and reuses it for matching requests. The key must include every input that can change the correct result.

Set an expiry and a deletion path. Private results must be isolated by user or tenant.
common_mistakes: One global cache key is safe for private users.
A high cache hit rate proves answers are fresh.
mini_exercise: Draw “Do Not Recompute the Same Answer” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Caching avoids repeated work and batching shares hardware work, but both require correctness and freshness rules.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Do Not Recompute the Same Answer” to explain Caching & Batching plainly.
